title: Toolchains
description: config/toolchains.yml: the synthesis toolchains. One with SupportedOperations has a driver module toolchains/<Id>.py; one without is catalogue-only.

SupportedOperations.description: The driver methods that exist; [] marks a catalogue-only toolchain

KnownVersions.description: Versions seen in the wild, so a chip's constraint can name a range

Version.description: The configured version pin, or null

InstallDir.description: Where the toolchain lives locally (~ and $VAR expand), or null to detect it
